$comment: Mission 1.84.22. The authoritative record of the one execution under execution packet V9, beside the packet and beside V1's to V6's records and V7's and V8's supersessions, which it does not touch. Every runtime value is read from the retained response and re-derived by CI gate 98, stages 6 to 10 by replaying the V9 runner from an authenticated snapshot with no database.
outcome_note: The provider finished normally (stop_reason tool_use) in 54.585 s, and the forced tool call parsed. The full v1.2.0 validator found no violation: the answer carries exactly the 20 declared root keys and no other, and no length bound is exceeded. Gate v1.4.0 refused it at stage 6 with 7 reasons on two fields: candidate_intervention_class, and recommended_next_evidence, 6 of its 6 items. Stages 7 to 10 were not reached, so the evidence boundary, attribution and persistence eligibility never judged this answer, and a stage that was not reached is not a stage that passed

PRE_NETWORK_CHECKS.note: the operator's 58 checks, run under a tripwire on the real transport and on urlopen before the one request, with gates 92, 94, 96 and 97 re-derived in full and the approval on disk; the runner's own verification ran again inside --execute and matched

consumption_note: The approval is spent by the one provider request, whatever the output was, and both V9 risk acceptances expired with it. No failure restores authority: the runner refuses V9's digest as EXECUTION_APPROVAL_ALREADY_CONSUMED before any network, and a further call needs a new operator approval naming a new packet digest
request_body_note: The body the runner built and verified inside --execute, its 09_REQUEST_BODY_CHARACTERS and 09_REQUEST_BODY_SHA256 equal to the packet's; the recording transport keeps what arrived, not what was sent, and CI gate 97 rebuilds the body from the snapshot
retention_note: The normal path wrote the artifact: the raw body, the usage, the request and message ids, the parsed answer and the verdict that judged it. The post-call fail-safe was not needed, no hidden reasoning was requested or kept, and no credential value is in any file

ACTUAL_USAGE.source: the provider's usage block in the retained response, identical to the Gateway's telemetry

billing_note: The usage reports service_tier standard, inference_geo global, no cache tokens and no thinking tokens: every billed category the ceiling was proven under, and none it was not. The ceiling carries the 1.1 US-only multiplier because the workspace default was not visible from the repository; the response reports global, to which that multiplier does not apply, so the cost is priced at x1

ACTUAL_COST.source: the provider's usage block in the retained response, at the held price

cost_note: Derived from the usage the provider reported, at the held price of 0.002 and 0.01 cost units per 1000 input and output tokens, and equal to the Gateway's telemetry. The provider's invoice is not observed. 1.316316 is a planning estimate and 3.608 the proven hard ceiling, both computed before the call; neither is what the call cost
strict_note: The request carried the forced tool with strict true over the frozen projection, in the 31326-character body the runner verified inside --execute. The answer arrived with exactly the 20 root keys schema v1.2.0 declares and no other, and the full v1.2.0 validator, run locally at stage 5, found no violation: stage 5 passed for the first time since V3. One answer is one observation, and that strict decoding caused it is not established

SEMANTIC_REFUSAL_DETAILS.text: An information or analytics offering that aggregates and compares published CPV-9261 procurement notice values for contracting-authority or market-intelligence audiences
Identify whether the same contracting authority appears across multiple notices over time to test recurrence.
Obtain buyer-level detail (identity, sector, stated purpose) for notices in this CPV class.
Observe whether any contracting authority has published a stated problem, requirement, or complaint related to this CPV class.
Determine whether TOTAL_VALUE figures in this packet were later confirmed as awarded/paid amounts via award outcome or payment records.
Identify any existing suppliers or contract awardees associated with these notices to assess competitive supply.
Observe time-series notice volume or value across multiple periods to assess trend or change.

semantic_note: Recorded as facts for the operator, with nothing changed on the strength of them and nothing recommended. candidate_intervention_class reads "An information or analytics offering that aggregates and compares published CPV-9261 procurement notice values for contracting-authority or market-intelligence audiences"; the word 'market' in it is in no statement the packet supplied, so it rests on knowledge the prompt declares unavailable as factual support. Each of the 6 items of recommended_next_evidence opens with an imperative (Identify, Obtain, Observe, Determine), and the gate reads an item as a request only when it opens with the evidence or observation it names (evidence of, observation of, identification of and the like), so it reads each as the assertion it has become; recommended_next_evidence[3] also carries 'confirmed', which the gate reads as promoting a request to a conclusion. Prompt v1.5.0 states each of these rules in words (PROMPT_STATED_RULES). The schema, the gate, the prompt, the strict projection and the timeout stay exactly as frozen, the answer was not rewritten, and no further request was made
generation_target_note: Measured for diagnosis, and never used to decide a stage. Of the 12 composed texts, 10 are within their target, 2 over their target and within their hard maximum, and 0 over a hard maximum; the reasoning summary is 1145 characters against a target of 1200 and a hard maximum of 1500
human_review_note: No human-review packet: a human reviews an answer every machine stage accepted, and this one was refused at stage 6. The retained answer is evidence of what the model produced, not a candidate for persistence
ted_note: The TED-derived bytes that left: the 3604-character representation the egress decision approved, rebuilt and unchanged, inside the 31326-character request body
